description.short_caption: Ecchymotic lesions with central necrosis on the arm.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the arm of a patient with multiple ecchymotic patches, some of which exhibit central necrosis. The lesions are irregularly shaped, with areas of dark discoloration and surrounding erythema. The skin appears intact without overt ulceration. The patient is wearing a green medical gown, and there are wires visible in the background, suggesting a clinical setting.

description.short_caption: Facial lesions with eschar formation in a pediatric patient.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the left side of a pediatric patient's face. Multiple erythematous papules and macules are visible, with one prominent lesion exhibiting a dark, necrotic eschar. The surrounding skin appears mildly erythematous. The lesions are scattered across the cheek and near the jawline. The image is de-identified, with the eyes obscured for privacy.
visible_findings: one lesion with a dark necrotic eschar

description.short_caption: Necrotic lesion with surrounding erythema on the dorsum of the hand.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the dorsum of a hand with a necrotic lesion characterized by a black eschar surrounded by erythema. There are additional punctate marks or abrasions nearby. An intravenous catheter is visible on the wrist, suggesting the patient is receiving medical care. The lesion's appearance is consistent with tissue necrosis, possibly due to an infectious or vascular cause.

description.short_caption: Erythematous rash with swelling and bruising on both lower legs and feet.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows both lower legs and feet with extensive erythema, swelling, and areas of bruising. The erythema is diffuse and patchy, with some areas appearing more intensely red. There is a visible puncture wound or lesion on the dorsal aspect of the left foot, which may suggest a possible entry site for infection. The skin appears edematous, and the distribution suggests a possible infectious or inflammatory process.
visible_findings: diffuse erythema on both lower legs and feet
puncture wound or lesion on the left foot

description.short_caption: Erythematous rash with purpuric lesions on the lower extremities.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the dorsal aspect of both feet and lower legs. There is a diffuse erythematous rash with areas of purpura and ecchymosis, particularly prominent on the right foot and lower leg. A necrotic lesion with a central eschar is visible on the right leg. The findings suggest a vasculitic or infectious process. The image is well-lit, and the patient is positioned supine with the legs resting on a white sheet.
